name: Return Of Christ
overview: The Return of Christ is a future event marked by the second coming of Jesus, who will appear without sin to bring salvation to those who eagerly await Him, as Hebrews 9:28 explains. Scripture emphasizes the certainty and suddenness of this event, warning believers to remain vigilant and ready since no one knows the exact day or hour except the Father (Matthew 24:36, 24:44). Jesus Himself assures that He will come quickly, bringing rewards according to each person's deeds (Revelation 22:12), highlighting the importance of faithful living in anticipation of His return.
